Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_n_rec number(3) := :system.cursor_record;
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_Failure;
 --Check if the new product code is defined in the master code

If :thaw_method is null
 then
 clear_record;
 IF temp_n_rec != 1 THEN
 next_record;
 END IF; 
 show_error('0142');
 /*if :system.trigger_record != 1
 then
 DUPLICATE_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;

 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;*/
 Else
 begin
 select distinct bag_id into :catalog_number
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and

 product_code = :new_product_code;
 exception

 when NO_DATA_FOUND

 end;

--SCR # 216, 910
 select count(*) into nCount from master_codes where code_type='FCRYO' and
 code=substr(:new_product_code,1,5) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+11);
 If ncount =0 then

 Else

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_add_on_bags number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_no_of_discards number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_sep_ind number(1);
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

begin
 -- time zone change --5/15/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;


 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select thaw_method, thaw_temperature,
 dummy_product_code, actual_product_code,
 freeze_time, cryo_ok_flag, sep_ind
 into :thaw_method, :thaw_temperature,
 :old_product_code, :new_product_code,
 :freeze_time, :cryo_ok_flag, temp_sep_ind
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0186');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code,
 null , 
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 if temp_sep_ind = 3
 then
 begin
 select third_sep_centrifuge_id,
 third_sep_time
 into :centrifuge_id, :sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 else
 if temp_sep_ind = 2
 then
 begin
 select second_sep_centrifuge_id,
 second_sep_time
 into :centrifuge_id,
 :sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :freeze_time is not null
 then
 message('Msg:Complete details for CRYO separation have been entered.');
 execute_trigger('key-clrrec');
 raise form_trigger_Failure;
 end if;
 if :thaw_method is null
 then
 --
 -- note that we don't check for presence of an
 -- additional bag because the CRYO stays in the same
 -- bag as the Destined CRYO bag
 --
 begin
 -- to check if the bag code
--HCLC select substr(bag_code,2,1) , nvl(add_on_bags,0),
 SELECT substr(bag_code,-1), nvl(add_on_bags,0),
 bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time,
 first_sep_time, second_sep_time
 into temp_bag_code, temp_add_on_bags,
 temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time,
 :GLOBAL.first_sep_time, :GLOBAL.second_sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if (temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null)
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0065');
 end if;
 default_value('','GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'N';
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 second_sep_time is not null;
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'Y';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'Y';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking for platelets');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('6');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :new_product_code is not null
 then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :new_product_code and
 (system_label_decision is null or
 system_label_decision in (
 SELECT distinct abo_label
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE identifier_code = 'EM'
 OR abo_label = 'Mq'
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'I'
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date 
 AND nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365)));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0099');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_gmt_time date;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;

--MS

 if :freeze_time is not null then
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :freeze_time, v_gmt_time); 
 :global.freeze_time := to_char(v_gmt_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else
 :global.freeze_time := to_char(:freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 end if;
 end if;
--
 
 --MS if :freeze_time <= :sep_time then
 if to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') <= :sep_time then --MS

 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('0058');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 
 --MS if :freeze_time > sysdate then
 if to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') >= sysdate then --MS

 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('0141');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_time_limit number(5,2);
 temp_max_temp number(5,2);
 temp_checkin_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_product_weight number(5,2);
 temp_production_time number(5,2);
 temp_min_ws_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_max_ws_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_min_sep_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_max_sep_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_ws_insert_dats date;
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(10);
 current_dats date;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 begin
 select nvl(min_ws_freeze_time,-99),
 nvl(max_ws_freeze_time,99),
 nvl(min_sep_freeze_time,-99),
 nvl(max_sep_freeze_time,99)
 into temp_min_ws_freeze_time, temp_max_ws_freeze_time,
 temp_min_sep_freeze_time, temp_max_sep_freeze_time
 from valid_cryo_methods
 where thaw_method = :thaw_method and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :cryo_ok_flag = 'N'
 then
 show_error('9789', 'CRYO'); -- Added by Kishore on 05/21/2011. IM 5605
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 05/21/2011. IM 5605
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRYO',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRYO not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
 -- check if the time interval between making the
 -- worksheet and freezing of the CRYO exceeds the allowable
 -- range
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'N';
 begin
 select insert_dats
 into temp_ws_insert_dats
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_time_difference :=
 --MS sbclib.calculate_time(temp_ws_insert_dats,:freeze_time);
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_ws_insert_dats, to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') ); --MS
 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 translate(temp_time_difference,':','.');
 if to_number(temp_time_difference) not between
 temp_min_ws_freeze_time and
 temp_max_ws_freeze_time
 then
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 show_error('9789', 'CRWS'); -- Added by Kishore on 05/21/2011. IM 5605
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 05/21/2011. IM 5605
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRWS',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRWS not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- check if the time interval between making the
 -- separation and freezing of the CRYO exceeds the allowable
 -- range
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'N';
 temp_time_difference :=
 --MS sbclib.calculate_time(:sep_time,:freeze_time);
 sbclib.calculate_time(:sep_time, to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') ); --MS
 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 translate(temp_time_difference,':','.');
 if to_number(temp_time_difference) not between
 temp_min_sep_freeze_time and
 temp_max_sep_freeze_time
 then
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 show_error('9789', 'CRSE'); -- Added by Kishore on 05/21/2011. IM 5605
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 05/21/2011. IM 5605
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRSE',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRSE not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
/*diptiia SCR 216 */

 --MS IF :freeze_time is not null
 IF :global.freeze_time is not null --MS
 THEN
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO component_cgmp
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code, aliquot, 
 parm_code, parm_value, process_dats, insert_dats, insert_user,
 program_id)
 VALUES
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :new_product_code, '1',
 'FRZ', 'A', to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'), sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in inserting into Component CGMP');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF; 
 
 begin
 update cryo_units
 set freeze_time = to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),
 cryo_ok_flag = :cryo_ok_flag,
 reject_reason_code = decode(:cryo_ok_flag,'Y','',
 'N','CRYO')
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating cryo_units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 commit;

 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
--message('Before validate_field. ');pause; 
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
--message('After validate_field. ');pause; 
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
-- message('In validate_field. ');pause;
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 -- message('Hello 1. ');pause;
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 -- message('Hello 2. ');pause;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 -- message('Hello 3. ');pause;

 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or

 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
--message('Hello 7. ');pause;
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
--message('Hello 8. ');pause;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
